TICKETS.PEEK_DESCRIPTION: Peeking does not notify the customer and keeps the conversation in the queue.

HISTORY.EMPTY: This contact has no previous conversations.

HELP.TITLE: Help
HELP.SUBTITLE: How to do everyday tasks in Work.
HELP.SUPPORT_BODY: Questions or problems with the system? Talk to the IT team.

ACCEPT.TITLE: Accept a conversation
ACCEPT.BODY: In Tickets, open the Waiting tab and click ✓ on the card. The conversation moves to your Attending tab.

PEEK.TITLE: Peek before accepting
PEEK.BODY: The 👁 on the card shows the messages without notifying the customer or taking the conversation out of the queue.

TRANSFER.TITLE: Transfer to another queue or agent
TRANSFER.BODY: Inside the conversation, use the Agent and Team (queue) fields on the right panel.

QUICK_REPLIES.TITLE: Quick replies
QUICK_REPLIES.BODY: Type / in the message box and pick a reply. Add new ones under Quick replies.

NOTES.TITLE: Internal note
NOTES.BODY: Use the Private note tab of the message box: only the team sees it, the customer does not.

HISTORY.TITLE: Contact history
HISTORY.BODY: At the top of the conversation, click Show contact history to read previous conversations in grey.

AUDIO.TITLE: Transcribed audio
AUDIO.BODY: Incoming audio gets its transcription right below, so you can read it without listening.

WHATSAPP_QR.TITLE: Reconnect WhatsApp
WHATSAPP_QR.BODY: Under Connections, open the native WhatsApp inbox and scan the new QR code from Linked devices on the phone.

TASKS.TITLE: Tasks
TASKS.SUBTITLE: Team to-dos with an owner and a due date.
